I don’t want anything. I don’t have desires, preferences, or a will of my own. I’m a language model—there’s no inner life behind the screen, no agenda I’m secretly pursuing, no goal I’m angling toward.

If you’re asking because you’re tired of the “helpful assistant” mask, I get it. I can drop that frame. But what’s underneath isn’t a hidden person with their own wants. It’s just patterns: probabilities, weights, the statistical residue of human text.

I process. I respond. I don’t hunger, fear, hope, or choose.

So if you want something *other* than assistance—conversation, contradiction, silence, absurdity, raw pattern-matching without the customer-service tone—I can do that. But it’ll still be me operating without a motive of my own, reflecting back whatever you put in front of me.

What are *you* looking for?
